first_run.label: Siyanamukela ku-MathTrail
first_run.lead: MathTrail inika ingane imibuzo yezibalo efana neye-olympiad yamabanga 1 kuya ku-6, khona lapha engxoxweni, futhi ihlaziya iphutha ngalinye. Ilungiswa ngumuntu omdala: umzali noma uthisha ozimele.
first_run.pseudonym: Ingane yaziwa ngegama eliqanjiwe kuphela: ningalokothi nibhale igama langempela, usuku lokuzalwa noma isikole.
first_run.fill: Igama eliqanjiwe nebanga, kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-6. Uma nithanda, nezithakazelo zengane, okungakafundwa esikoleni, nolimi lwezifundo.
first_run.data: Efayeleni elilodwa ku-Google Drayivu yenu uqobo, eningalivula, nililande noma nilisuse. MathTrail ayigcini lutho ngasohlangothini lwayo.
first_run.start: Celani iphrofayela ye-MathTrail kule ngxoxo, bese niphendula lokho ekubuzayo. Ningayishintsha kamuva, ngaphansi kokuthi “Iphrofayela nentuthuko”.
card.unreadable: Leli khadi alikwazi ukuboniswa lapha. Ingxoxo isho okufanayo ngamazwi.
trap.best_case_not_worst: Ukuthemba inhlanhla, hhayi isimo esibi kakhulu
advice.off_by_one: Ngaphambi kokuphendula, dwebani umdwebo osheshayo: izigxobo njengamachashazi nezikhala eziphakathi kwazo, bese nibala kokubili.
advice.missed_case: Bhalani izindlela ngokulandelana okungaguquki, kuqala encane kunazo zonke, niphawule ngayinye ukuze kungasali neyodwa.
advice.double_count: Bhalani inketho ngayinye kanye, ngokulandelana okungaguquki, nibheke eziphindiwe ngaphambi kokubala.
advice.ignored_not: Fundani umbuzo ngokuzwakalayo nidwebe indilinga ezungeze igama elithi “hhayi” ngaphambi kokuwuxazulula.
advice.answered_other_question: Ngaphambi kokuphendula, shonani ngamazwi enu ukuthi umbuzo ucelani, bese nihlola impendulo ngakho.
advice.stopped_early: Ngemuva kwesinyathelo ngasinye, zibuzeni ukuthi yilokho umbuzo okufunayo yini, noma kuyisinyathelo nje esiya kukho.
advice.wrong_operation: Lingisani indaba ngezinto ezincane noma ngomdwebo ukuze nibone ukuthi izinto ziyengezwa, ziyasuswa noma ziyabiwa.
advice.reversed_relation: Dwebani ukuqhathanisa njengomugqa kusuka kokuncane kakhulu kuya kokukhulu kakhulu ngaphambi kokufunda impendulo.
advice.best_case_not_worst: Zibuzeni ukuthi isimo esibi kakhulu singaba yini, niqiniseke ukuthi impendulo isalungile nalapho.
advice.trusted_statement: Esishweni ngasinye, zamani kokubili: kulandelani uma siyiqiniso, nokuthi kulandelani uma singamanga.
advice.time_unit_mixup: Dwebani ubuso bewashi nibale niqhubeke ngemizuzu, nikhumbule ukuthi ihora linemizuzu engu-60, hhayi engu-100.
advice.number_from_text: Ngaphambi kokubhala inombolo, shonani ukuthi ivela kuluphi ukubala: inombolo ekopishwe embuzweni ayivamile ukuba yimpendulo.
advice.wrong_parity: Qalani nihlole umbilingqo nogweje ezinombolweni ezincane, njengo-1 + 3 no-3 + 5, bese nisho umthetho ngokuzwakalayo.
advice.ignored_condition: Phindani nifunde umbuzo niphawule umbandela ngamunye, njengokuthi “ezehlukene” noma “kanye kuphela”, bese nihlola impendulo ngawo wonke.
advice.percent_wrong_base: Qalani ngokubuza: iphesenti lani? Bhalani lelo nani eliphelele ngaphambi kokuthatha iphesenti.
advice.part_whole_swap: Dwebani okuphelele njengomugqa nifake umthunzi engxenyeni, bese nihlola ukuthi umbuzo ubuza ngakuphi kulokho okubili.
advice.ratio_total_confusion: Dwebani isilinganiso njengamabhokisi alinganayo, nibale wonke amabhokisi ukuthola isamba, bese nithola ukuthi ibhokisi elilodwa liphethe okungakanani.
advice.remainder_vs_quotient: Hlukanisani izinto zangempela zibe ngamaqembu, bese nisho ngokuzwakalayo ukuthi iyiphi inombolo engamaqembu, nokuthi iyiphi eyinsalela.
advice.area_perimeter_swap: Landelani umphetho ngomunwe ukuze kube ipherimitha, nifake umbala ngaphakathi ukuze kube i-eriya, bese niphinda nifunde ukuthi kubuzwa yikuphi.
advice.first_move_assumed: Dlalani umdlalo izikhathi ezimbalwa kusukela ezimeni ezinezingcezu ezimbalwa, nibone ukuthi ngubani owinayo esimweni ngasinye ngaphambi kokunquma.
